claim: Compatible-backbone tokenizer reconstruction, not original-LLaMA1 paper reproduction
selection: First minimum collision rate at scheduled evaluations; no downstream test selection
declarations: Use the authors' RQ model, initialization, objectives and epoch routines with already documented parameter-wiring fixes.
All semantic banks use the separately licensed OpenLLaMA-7B-v2 encoder; all CF banks use audited train-only 32D BCE teachers.

Alpha/beta and other numerical values are the author-confirmed Instruments starting point, transferred without test tuning to Beauty/Yelp; they are not recovered per-dataset original tokenizer recipes.
Twenty thousand means epochs, not optimizer updates. A full Instruments catalog probe measured approximately 3.9 seconds per epoch before concurrent-load effects and scheduled collision evaluation.
Bitwise full-catalog Instruments continuation after epoch3 was verified against a fresh uninterrupted epoch4 across model, optimizer, initialization flags and RNG state.
Codebooks and exported four-token IDs remain distinct per variant. No fifth uniqueness token or substitution of the released author IDs is permitted.
